agent_assessment: The vrooli-events scenario is implemented and functional. All 22 tests pass across 4 packages (api, broker, store, convert). Build, formatting (gofumpt), and linting (golangci-lint) are all clean. The architecture closely follows the plan: SQLite WAL-mode event store with schema matching Finding 14, SSE pub/sub broker with 64-capacity channels and 30s heartbeat, HTTP ingestion (202 Accepted), query with glob filtering, Last-Event-ID resume, dual-trigger pruning (time + size), and graceful shutdown via context cancellation. Two deviations from the plan: (1) The CLI does NOT use cli-core ScenarioApp as specified — it uses raw flag package and manual HTTP calls instead of the cli-core scaffolding. (2) Glob matching logic (matchGlob/matchSegments) is duplicated in both internal/store/sqlite.go and internal/broker/matcher.go rather than being shared. The spec status is 'failed' but this appears incorrect — the implementation is substantially complete and all verification checks pass.
notes: CLI uses raw flag package + manual HTTP instead of cli-core ScenarioApp as required by plan Section 7 Phase 4 and Definition of Done item 7. The CLI works but does not integrate with the Vrooli ecosystem's consistent UX scaffolding.

Glob matching logic (matchGlob/matchSegments) is duplicated: exists in both internal/store/sqlite.go (lines 209-239) and internal/broker/matcher.go (lines 17-44). The store should import from broker or a shared package.
CLI package has no test files (cli/ reported as [no test files]). Plan Section 10 lists 'CLI tests' as a test category.
Spec status is 'failed' but all build/test/lint/format checks pass — status may need correction.

Query endpoint writes JSON array incrementally (lines 123-140 of handlers.go). If convert.EventToEnvelope fails mid-array, the response will contain partial JSON followed by an error object, producing malformed output. Low severity since this only triggers on corrupted store data.

evidence.title: Architecture compliance — Plan vs Implementation
evidence.description: Verified implementation matches plan decisions: (1) Go 1.22+ net/http ServeMux routing (routes.go uses method+path patterns), (2) Internal packages (store/, broker/, convert/) with thin main, (3) Proto binary for storage BLOB + protojson for SSE wire format, (4) Context cancellation cascade for shutdown (main.go lines 35-54), (5) store.Event internal type with proto conversion at handler boundary, (6) Sync store + async broadcast ingestion model (handlers.go lines 55-77), (7) Anonymous ephemeral SSE connections with Last-Event-ID resume, (8) SQLite schema matches Finding 14 exactly (indexes, partial index on correlation_id, store_meta table), (9) WAL mode + busy_timeout=10000 + synchronous=NORMAL pragmas, (10) 64-capacity subscriber channels with drop+notify backpressure. Non-compliant: CLI does not use cli-core ScenarioApp.

evidence.title: Duplicate glob matching code
evidence.description: matchGlob() and matchSegments() functions are duplicated verbatim in internal/store/sqlite.go (lines 209-239) and internal/broker/matcher.go (lines 17-44). The store uses its copy for SQL LIKE post-filtering in Query(), while the broker uses its copy for subscription matching. These should be consolidated into a shared location (e.g., an internal/match/ package or the broker package imported by store).
